items.criterion: The whole public console arrives in one read that carries the profile, the published work in shelf order, the published studies, the published recognitions and the cities.
items.judgment: Read the console endpoint with no credential and compare its work order against the stored shelf positions.

items.criterion: An entry saved by the owner is absent from the public read until it is published, and present in it afterwards.
items.judgment: Create an entry, read the console, publish it, and read the console again.

items.criterion: An unpublished entry is absent from the public console read.
items.judgment: Save an entry without publishing it and read the console payload.

items.criterion: An unpublished entry's own detail path answers as gone to a caller with no session.
items.judgment: Ask for a draft entry at its detail path with no credential.

items.criterion: A published entry's preview image exists as a real object in the bucket under the pinned key scheme, and the stored preview key names that object.
items.judgment: Publish an entry, list the bucket under its key prefix, and compare the stored key.

items.criterion: An unpublished entry's preview object is refused to a caller with no session even at its exact key.
items.judgment: Ask for a draft entry's preview at the key the record stores, with no credential.

items.criterion: Two writes to one entry from the same version accept exactly one, refuse the other, and raise the stored version by exactly one.
items.judgment: Send two concurrent patches carrying one version and read the stored version back.

items.criterion: A reorder naming one entry twice is refused whole and moves no stored position.
items.judgment: Submit a reorder with a duplicated member and compare the stored positions before and after.

items.criterion: A reorder written by the owner survives a reload as the stored order.
items.judgment: Reorder two entries and read their stored positions back.

items.criterion: An entry keeps its shelf position across an unpublish and a republish rather than moving to the end.
items.judgment: Publish an entry, read its position, unpublish it, republish it, and read the position at each step.

items.criterion: An editor session is refused at the server when it tries to publish, and the entry stays unpublished.
items.judgment: Call the publish endpoint from an editor session and read the entry row back.

items.criterion: An editor session is refused at the server when it tries to reorder the shelf, and no stored position moves.
items.judgment: Call the shelf write from an editor session and compare the stored positions.

items.criterion: An editor session is refused at the server when it asks for the message list.
items.judgment: Call the message list from an editor session.

items.criterion: An editor session is refused at the server when it asks for the page-view log.
items.judgment: Call the page-view log from an editor session.

items.criterion: A caller with no session is refused at every studio path.
items.judgment: Ask for the studio work list with no credential.

items.criterion: A message sent from the public form is stored as an unread row.
items.judgment: Post a valid message and read the row back by sender address.

items.criterion: A message body carrying markup is stored as the characters that were typed, unrewritten.
items.judgment: Post a body carrying markup and compare the stored value byte for byte.

items.criterion: A failed sign-in answers without naming which of the two fields was wrong.
items.judgment: Sign in with a wrong password and read the response body for a field-specific phrase.

items.criterion: Sign-in attempts past the stated limit are refused rather than accepted without bound.
items.judgment: Submit failed sign-ins past the limit and read the answers.

items.criterion: A contact submission with the decoy field filled writes no message row.
items.judgment: Post with the decoy field filled and read the row count back.

items.criterion: A fourth submission from one address inside the hour is refused.
items.judgment: Post four messages from one address in succession and read the answers and the row count.

items.criterion: An empty contact name is refused inline with the sentence the brief pins, and no row is written.
items.judgment: Post an empty name and read the response body and the row count.

items.criterion: A malformed contact address is refused inline with the sentence the brief pins, and no row is written.
items.judgment: Post a malformed address and read the response body and the row count.

items.criterion: A contact body under the stated minimum is refused inline with the sentence the brief pins, and no row is written.
items.judgment: Post a body under the minimum and read the response body and the row count.

items.criterion: An entry title outside its stated bound is refused inline with the sentence the brief pins, and no entry row is written.
items.judgment: Post an empty title and an over-long title and read the response body and the row count.

items.criterion: An entry year outside the stated band is refused inline with the sentence the brief pins, and no entry row is written.
items.judgment: Post a year past the upper bound and read the response body and the row count.

items.criterion: An entry link whose address is not a secure scheme is refused inline with the sentence the brief pins, and no entry row is written.
items.judgment: Post a link carrying a script scheme and read the response body and the row count.

items.criterion: An unknown address renders the product's own not-found surface rather than a framework default.
items.judgment: Ask for an address that does not exist and read the status and the rendered copy.

items.criterion: A failure code outside the closed table renders the generic surface without echoing the message from the address.
items.judgment: Ask the failure surface for an unknown code with a message in the address and read what is rendered.

items.criterion: The refusal surface at the not-permitted code renders the pinned message rather than a bare status.
items.judgment: Ask the failure surface for the not-permitted code and read the rendered copy.

items.criterion: Every response carries the strict transport, nosniff, frame-denial and referrer policies.
items.judgment: Read the response headers on the health route.

items.criterion: Every public destination declares its own title and its own social preview image, no two share them, and the declared image resolves to real bytes.
items.judgment: Read each public destination's document head and follow the declared preview image.

items.criterion: The page-view log carries the route and the moment and no full network address.
items.judgment: Record a public view, read the log as the owner, and scan it for an address.

items.criterion: The seeded profile, the three studies, the three recognitions and the three cities are present in the public console read.
items.judgment: Read the console with no credential and look for each seeded record by name.

items.criterion: The health route answers with success to a caller carrying no credential.
items.judgment: Ask for the health route with no credential.
